root_cause_analysis: The visual audit module triggered a pipeline halt due to non-compliance with brand identity guidelines. Specifically, the presence of English-transliterated Tamil ('FBI-oda') and the lack of native Tamil numerals in highlight boxes failed the localization quality threshold, preventing the generation of a culturally authentic asset.
actionable_instructions: Update the content generation prompt to enforce the use of authentic Tamil script ('FBI-யின்') instead of transliterated English.
Modify the CSS template to map numeric values to Tamil numerals or ensure font-family 'Mukta Malar' is correctly applied to all UI elements.
Re-run the pipeline after verifying the updated font-family and text-normalization logic in the template engine.
